hooks.command: sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_STDIN_TIMEOUT_S:-5s}" cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; (timeout "${RED_SKILLS_HOOK_TIMEOUT_S:-3s}" node "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bootstrap.mjs" hook SessionStart --runner codex <"$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f "$tmp") & printf "{}"'
